title: EvaluationContract v1
description: Adapter-layer exchange type: the evaluation contract derived from one case payload — the evidence category and maturity rung each claim type needs for promotion, the forbidden evidence channels, and case-specific checkpoints. case_sha256 binds the exact case payload the contract was derived from. The contract's own canonical hash can be pinned into core evidence inputs (kind="config", sha256 required) so 'which contract judged this' stays auditable; the contract itself is an exchange type and never enters the store.

case_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the case payload this contract was derived from. Hash binding, not a locator.

min_maturity.description: Minimum governance ladder rung the evidence supporting this claim type must reach inside this case.

required_evidence.description: Per-claim-type promotion requirements for this case. A contract with no requirements evaluates nothing.

forbidden_channels.description: Evidence channels that must never support promotion in this case (for example numeric-extrapolation-as-proof, future-function features, non-PIT data, misaligned labels). Required; write an explicit empty array only after consideration.

checkpoints.description: Case-specific checkpoint list (for example gate identifiers with their freeze assertions). Required; may be an explicit empty array.
